extract bytes input from PDF document

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\"}", "{}")
```
